name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a Reno, Nevada-based natural resource company operating a three-pronged business model of mineral royalty creation and acquisition, precious metals streaming, and an exploration project accelerator. The company holds a portfolio of royalties and properties in Nevada's highest-grade historical gold mining districts, including positions in the Walker Lane shear zone and Elko County. The company is in the early development and exploration stage with minimal operating overhead relative to conventional mining companies.
